questions.stem: Which general word refers to the thing inside?
questions.listenScript: Inside the mystery bag is a physical thing. You may feel its shape with your hand, but you cannot see it yet.

listenLines.text: Inside the mystery bag is a physical thing. You may feel its shape with your hand, but you cannot see it yet.

questions.explanation: An object is a physical thing that can be touched.
questions.parentExplanation: object表示可以触摸的实物。

translation.stem: 哪个概括性词表示里面的实物？
translation.listenScript: 神秘袋里有一个实物，你可以伸手摸它的形状，但暂时看不到它。

questions.stem: What kind of animal is the ant?
questions.listenScript: An ant crosses the path. We count its six legs and watch it walk towards a crack in the ground.

listenLines.text: An ant crosses the path. We count its six legs and watch it walk towards a crack in the ground.

questions.explanation: An ant is an insect.
questions.parentExplanation: 蚂蚁属于昆虫。

translation.stem: 蚂蚁是哪类动物？
translation.listenScript: 一只蚂蚁横穿小路，我们数出它的六条腿，看它走向地上的裂缝。

questions.stem:
The colourful cover is designed to attract readers who enjoy stories about the sea.
What does “attract” mean here?

translation.stem: 这本书彩色的封面旨在吸引喜欢海洋故事的读者。 这里“attract”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “attract” means “make people interested”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“attract”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“make people interested”。对应源表释义为“吸引；招引”。

wordHelp.meaning: objects arranged for people to look at

The workshop uses recycled wood to produce shelves for the school library.
What does “produce” mean here?

translation.stem: 工坊用回收木料为学校图书馆制作书架。 这里“produce”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “produce” means “make things for use”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“produce”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“make things for use”。对应源表释义为“生产；制造”。

questions.explanation: Here, “put on” means “to stage or perform a play”.

questions.stem:
We move the tables and put up decorations. We get the room ready for the class party.
What does “get the room ready for” mean here?

translation.stem: 我们移动桌子，挂上装饰品。我们把房间准备好，用来举办班级聚会。 这里“get the room ready for”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “get ... ready for” means “to prepare something so that it can be used for an event or purpose”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“get ... ready for”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“to prepare something so that it can be used for an event or purpose”。对应源表释义为“准备好……”。

questions.stem: We walk to school every morning; we go there o________.
questions.hint: Use the two-word travel expression meaning by walking.
questions.explanation: Walking to a place is going there on foot.
questions.parentExplanation: 步行用on foot；foot单数，不加冠词。

translation.stem: 我们每天早晨走路上学；我们步行去那里。

questions.stem: I wake up at seven but g________ at ten past seven, when I finally leave the bed.
questions.hint: Use the two-word phrase meaning leave the bed after waking.
questions.explanation: Leaving the bed is getting up, which can happen after waking.
questions.parentExplanation: 七点醒、七点十分离床，区分wake up和get up。

translation.stem: 我七点醒来，但七点十分才起床，终于离开床。

questions.stem: Mia g________ at nine, but stays awake for a short bedtime story.
questions.hint: Use the phrase meaning gets into bed to sleep; make the verb agree with Mia.
questions.grammar: 第三人称单数goes to bed
questions.explanation: Mia gets into bed before sleeping; the singular form is goes to bed.
questions.parentExplanation: Mia单数用goes；上床后尚未睡着，明确是go to bed。

translation.stem: 米娅九点上床，但会再醒着听一会儿睡前故事。

questions.stem: The old cooking tools in the museum show us the d________ of village families a hundred years ago.
questions.hint: Use the two-word phrase for ordinary everyday living; use life in the singular.
questions.grammar: the daily life of + 人群
questions.explanation: Cooking tools help show how families lived from day to day.
questions.parentExplanation: 普通家庭日常的生活方式是daily life；按提示用life单数。

translation.stem: 博物馆里的旧炊具让我们了解一百年前乡村家庭的日常生活。

questions.stem: Mia is l________ seeing her grandparents during the holiday.
questions.hint: Use the -ing form of the three-word phrase meaning happily expecting a future event.
questions.explanation: After is use looking forward to; the preposition to is followed by seeing.
questions.parentExplanation: is后用looking形成进行时；to在此为介词，后接seeing。

translation.stem: 米娅期待假期里见到祖父母。

questions.stem: Mia t________ the school concert as a singer every year.
questions.hint: Use the phrase meaning participates in an activity; make it agree with Mia.
questions.grammar: 第三人称单数takes part in
questions.explanation: Mia participates as a singer, so she takes part in the concert.
questions.parentExplanation: 单数主语Mia配takes part in；后面接活动concert。

translation.stem: 米娅每年都以歌手身份参加学校音乐会。

questions.stem: The school fair is a great s________: many visitors come, and everyone enjoys it.
questions.hint: Use the noun for an event that achieves its aims very well.
questions.explanation: An event that achieves its aims can be called a success.
questions.parentExplanation: 此处a great success表示一件成功的事，success在这一用法中可数。

translation.stem: 学校集市很成功：许多人来参加，每个人都玩得开心。

questions.stem: T________ people come to the festival; the crowd is far too large to count quickly.
questions.hint: a very large number, in many groups of a thousand
questions.explanation: Use thousands of for a large, inexact number.
questions.parentExplanation: thousands of表示成千上万，非确定数目；句首Thousands可大写。

translation.stem: 数以千计的人来参加节庆；人群太多，无法很快数清。

questions.explanation: In sentence 2, “include” means “have something as one part” in this situation.

passages.text: The cooking club puts together a box of ingredients for a simple class demonstration. The ingredients include oats and dried fruit, and the teacher checks the written list. One pupil brings a bar of chocolate that will be broken into smaller pieces. The group weighs each ingredient before mixing anything, so it can follow the same recipe again. When an amount is wrong, they correct it before moving to the next step. Their notebook records the final amounts rather than the first guesses.

parallelText.en: The cooking club puts together a box of ingredients for a simple class demonstration.
parallelText.zh: 烹饪社团把简单课堂演示所需食材装进一个盒子。

parallelText.en: The ingredients include oats and dried fruit, and the teacher checks the written list.
parallelText.zh: 食材包括燕麦和果干，老师核对书面清单。

parallelText.en: One pupil brings a bar of chocolate that will be broken into smaller pieces.
parallelText.zh: 一位学生带来一条巧克力，之后要把它掰成小块。

parallelText.en: The group weighs each ingredient before mixing anything, so it can follow the same recipe again.
parallelText.zh: 小组混合前称量每种食材，以便以后能按相同配方再做。

parallelText.en: When an amount is wrong, they correct it before moving to the next step.
parallelText.zh: 数量不对时，他们先改正，再进入下一步。

parallelText.en: Their notebook records the final amounts rather than the first guesses.
parallelText.zh: 笔记本记录最终数量，而不是最初的猜测。

wordHelp.meaning: foods used to make a dish
a grain often used in breakfast food
instructions for preparing food

passages.text: After lunch, Jun notices a bright wrapper lying beside an open classroom window. He thinks it will stay there until the classroom cleaning time. A sudden breeze carries it outside, and it catches on a low bush in the garden. This result makes Jun realise that waiting was not a good choice. He asks a teacher before going outside, then collects the litter and puts it in the proper bin. Next time, he plans to deal with loose litter promptly rather than leave it near a window.

parallelText.en: After lunch, Jun notices a bright wrapper lying beside an open classroom window.
parallelText.zh: 午饭后，俊发现打开的教室窗边有一张鲜艳的包装纸。

parallelText.en: He thinks it will stay there until the classroom cleaning time.
parallelText.zh: 他以为它会一直在那里，直到教室清洁时间。

parallelText.en: A sudden breeze carries it outside, and it catches on a low bush in the garden.
parallelText.zh: 一阵风突然把它吹出去，挂在花园低矮的灌木上。

parallelText.en: This result makes Jun realise that waiting was not a good choice.
parallelText.zh: 这个结果让俊意识到等待并不是好选择。

parallelText.en: He asks a teacher before going outside, then collects the litter and puts it in the proper bin.
parallelText.zh: 他先询问老师再出去，随后捡起垃圾并放进合适的垃圾桶。

parallelText.en: Next time, he plans to deal with loose litter promptly rather than leave it near a window.
parallelText.zh: 下次他打算及时处理散落垃圾，不再把它留在窗边。

wordHelp.meaning: a light wind
a low plant with many branches
without unnecessary delay
